senses.sense_definition: The faith, practices, and doctrines of the Catholic Church, especially the Roman Catholic Church.

examples.text: <w>Catholicism</w> is the largest Christian denomination in the world today.
Many people find comfort in the traditions of <w>Catholicism</w>.

senses.sense_definition: The state or quality of being universal or all-encompassing.

examples.text: The <w>catholicism</w> of his interests allowed him to converse with experts in many different fields.
She admired the <w>catholicism</w> of the organization, which welcomed members from every corner of the globe.

senses.sense_definition: A broadness of mind or liberality of sentiment.

examples.text: His <w>catholicism</w> of taste meant he enjoyed everything from classical music to modern pop.
The professor was known for the <w>catholicism</w> of her views, always considering multiple perspectives.
